entities.summary: Gavin Roy Pelham Ashenden is a British Catholic layman, author and commentator, and associate editor of the Catholic Herald. Formerly a priest of the Church of England, and subsequently a continuing Anglican bishop, he was appointed Chaplain to the Queen from 2008 until his resignation in 2017.
